title: Smoky Uruguayan Mackerel Bake
description: A simple, smoky Uruguayan-inspired mackerel dish baked to perfection. This recipe combines the rich flavors of smoky Uruguayan spices with the delicate taste of mackerel.
instructions: Season the mackerel fillets with smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the mackerel fillets for 2 minutes on each side, until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix the minced garlic and chopped parsley in a small bowl.
Remove the skillet from the oven and top each mackerel fillet with the garlic-parsley mixture and a drizzle of lemon juice.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
